Context: on adoption of child

## on adoption of child  
1. Granted to a female employee, with fewer than two surviving children, on accepting a child in pre-adoption foster care or on valid adoption of a child below the age of one year, for a period of 180 days immediately after accepting the child in pre-adoption foster care or from the date of valid adoption. Child includes a child taken as ward under the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 subject to conditions.
